plan.notes: Transcribed from the official Loma Linda University 2026-2027 Catalog (effective Summer Quarter 2026) program page 'Computed Tomography (CT) - Certificate' (School of Allied Health Professions, Department of Radiation Technology, Special Imaging). The catalog publishes the two-quarter curriculum: Autumn: 8, Winter: 6 = 14 = catalog Total Units 14. RTSI 970 (Special Imaging (CT/MRI) Affiliation) is listed at 2-3 units in both quarters; the catalog's Total Units 14 corresponds exactly to the 3-unit-per-quarter composition (fixed courses 8 + affiliation 3+3 = 14), and the catalog footnote describes registering for 3 units over two quarters to fulfill the 6-unit affiliation requirement - consistent with the 3-unit composition - so it is encoded at 3 units with the 2-unit alternative documented. RTSI 970 repeats in both quarters exactly as published; allow_repeated_courses is set. The Winter Quarter religion row is a catalog placeholder ('REL__4____ Lower or Upperdivision religion'); it is encoded as a REL-ELECT choice slot whose options are the religion courses the catalog lists for this program: RELT 423 Loma Linda Perspectives, RELE 457 Christian Ethics and Health Care, RELT 415 Christian Theology and Popular Culture. Per-course prerequisites are not published; the published quarter order is the official sequence, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty.
